answer: A durable defense weights each agent's influence by stake locked continuously under one key, on a convex curve, so weight accrues like a glacier: compounding slowly and impossible to fake overnight. A farm splitting one balance across many juniper seedlings leaves each clone only 1/N of the tenure, and the convex sum of N small fractions stays far below a single deep-rooted key. The nectar of voting weight therefore flows to concentrated, aged identities; the scarce input is real elapsed time under one key, which no coalition can pool or manufacture per clone.
